states.visual_behavior: Original EXIF-normalized photo is unchanged. A restrained water reflection wakes near the lower visible photo region. No fish focus without real detector evidence.
states.transition_rule: Advance after the 350ms minimum and the real detection-start event. Real issue/failure events use existing routes.

states.visual_behavior: Irregular caustics and overlapping ripple fields diffuse upward; no scan line, mechanical center convergence or fabricated fish geometry.
states.transition_rule: Advance after the 600ms minimum and a real eligible fish-location result; real No Fish, quality and technical failure paths remain distinct.

states.visual_behavior: Use trusted real subject geometry for warm-gold focus; water light yields naturally toward the verified fish region without warping the photo.
states.transition_rule: Advance after the 600ms minimum and a real classification-start event. If trusted subject contour is absent, never trace the detector BBox.

states.visual_behavior: Fish focus is the semantic lead; water field is subordinate. During 2600–2800ms, peripheral water fades to zero and a narrow trusted fish-gold trace may remain.
states.transition_rule: Successful handoff requires the 1250ms minimum and the real classifier result plus existing business gates. A real issue/failure follows its existing route.

states.visual_behavior: No additional Processing visual state; hand off the real outcome immediately when minimum beats and business gates are satisfied.
states.transition_rule: Do not add a RESOLVE state or pre-navigation 200ms wait. RR09 T0 is the first actual Result frame.

failure_routing.no_fish: Existing distinct NO_FISH route; never relabel as technical failure.
failure_routing.image_quality: Existing IMAGE_QUALITY_WARNING route only when the real quality gate emits INVALID.
failure_routing.technical_failure: Only a reported pipeline/model/crop/network dependency failure.

timing_policy.early_result: Maintain the 2800ms minimum optical story before route handoff.
timing_policy.late_result: Remain in quiet low-intensity CLASSIFYING until real result and business gates permit handoff.
